*I’d hold shipping for one high-priority bug.*

*P1 — Month-end renewals use the wrong month’s length* — `src/schedule.js:6–7`
The day is clamped to the *source* month’s length, then used to construct a date in the *next* month. JavaScript rolls invalid dates into the following month, so this can skip a renewal month or renew on the wrong day.

Reproduced with anchor `31`:
• Jan 31, 2026 → *Mar 3*, expected Feb 28.
• Feb 28, 2026 → *Mar 28*, expected Mar 31.
• Apr 30, 2026 → *May 30*, expected May 31.
• Jan 31, 2028 → *Mar 2*, expected Feb 29.

The clamp needs to use the *target month’s* length while retaining the original anchor. Add regression tests for shorter-month transitions, returning to a longer month, and leap February.

*Validation:* All 5 existing tests pass, but a 2026–2029 month/anchor matrix produced 54 incorrect results out of 1,488 cases. Proration matches the documented calendar-month rule; I found no additional bugs.

Reviewed `billing-anniversary` at `f73b00d` against `main` at `7f89e48`. No files changed.
